text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks before the Kikuka-sho—
I was watching footage of this year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe together with Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For the past five years, Japanese Umamusume had run consecutively, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This year, no one took up the challenge of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Thinking about this is pointless.
I know that. But still...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(What if... what if
I had run in that race...?)
choice_data_list: If it were Dura, she would've overtaken them

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until they turned into the straight, there was no fierce jockeying for position, and the Umamusume stayed tightly packed.
With every corner they turned, the pack gradually strung out into a line.
choice_data_list: At this pace, you'll want to settle into the middle of the pack.
At this pace, you'll want to settle into the middle of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A battle on the final straight is her specialty.
I can already picture her bursting through the wall of Umamusume with flashing speed...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...And will I win?
choice_data_list: With your powerful late-stretch kick, I know you can do it!
With your powerful finishing kick, I'm sure we can do it!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
You can see the world clearly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer really is
so reliable.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"We can't leave the preparations
all to you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho...
I'll win, and prove how strong I am.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Duramente's own hard work and the support of her family, the physical concerns we had after the Derby are practically gone.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...No,
I'll be honest with you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I do have just a bit
of anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Lack of experience in long-distance races.
This might turn out to be a tough result."
choice_data_list: Still, you're going out there intending to win.
But you're going in intending to win

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No,
I just thought it was rather strange."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"When you say 'it's okay'...
it really puts me at ease."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's take on the challenge. The final crown,
the Kikuka Sho——"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, race day arrived.
Opinions on Duramente were split into two camps.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, but come on, it's Duramente we're talking about!
She's super strong. She must've grown even more over the summer, so there's no doubt she has no rivals in her generation!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, weren't there rumors about an injury?
I kind of doubt whether she can conquer such a grueling long distance.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, when I looked at the paddock earlier...
I was kind of surprised."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did "that girl"
always have such an aura—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...It's fine.
The one who will become the strongest Umamusume is...—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan,
you...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (What is this feeling...? It's like... facing a giant.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dura-san,
I've... gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dura-san carries so much on her shoulders... and her heart is strong, too.
She's an incredible Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to...
win too, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't lose when it comes to this feeling!!
—The one who's gonna win is me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
You've made up your mind, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then that's all the more reason...
I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The strongest Umamusume—is me.
